runId.description: Use self for a goal in the same frozen run; otherwise use the explicit source run ID. A relation never resolves or replaces the source verdict.

actionObservationWindow.title: Action observation window
actionObservationWindow.description: Actual observation bounds and their source. Runtime validation additionally checks that endedAt is not earlier than startedAt; this window does not create a product SLA.

actionEvent.title: Action event
actionEvent.description: One immutable fact event of an action attempt. The kind-specific fields below are conditional requirements, not a fixed execution route. Dispatch acceptance is separate from business result; unknown facts may be recorded without inventing evidence. IDs, source ownership, previous-event references and timestamp ordering are checked by the runtime.

testFileDescription.title: Test file description
testFileDescription.description: Actual retained test file name and provenance, independent of input/output use. No case-design-time file generation.

testFileUse.title: Actual test file use
testFileUse.description: Either a retained original reference, or an explicit missing/unknown original. The runtime validates action/observation/case ownership.
